title: Artificial Intelligence
summary: Generative AI, AI agents, document intelligence and predictive analytics — designed for production and measurable outcomes.
intro: We design AI that automates knowledge work, reveals patterns in data and supports faster, better-informed decisions — with secure integration, governed data and workflows that fit your organisation.
body:
## Built for production, not just the demo

Many AI initiatives stall between a promising pilot and a system people rely on every day. We close that gap by treating AI as part of a complete software system: data pipelines, evaluation, security, user experience and operations are designed together from the start.

## Private and secure by design

Where data is sensitive, we deploy models on your own infrastructure or in a private cloud, keep humans in the loop for critical decisions and log what the system does so results can be audited.
capabilities: Generative AI, LLM applications and private AI deployments
Retrieval-augmented generation and enterprise knowledge search
Machine learning, forecasting and predictive analytics
AI strategy, readiness assessment and governance

outcomes.title: Less manual knowledge work
outcomes.text: Automate reading, classifying, summarising and routing of documents and requests.

outcomes.title: Decisions backed by data
outcomes.text: Forecasts and recommendations that are explainable and integrated into existing tools.

outcomes.title: Your data stays yours
outcomes.text: On-premise, private-cloud and open-model options for sensitive environments.

outcomes.title: Measurable results
outcomes.text: Clear evaluation metrics agreed up front, and monitored after go-live.

title: Computer Vision
summary: Real-time video analytics that detect, count, track and inspect — running at the edge, on-premise or in the cloud.
intro: We turn cameras into intelligent sensors. Our computer-vision systems analyse video in real time to detect objects and events, measure activity and automate visual inspection.
body:
## From pixels to decisions

Video is one of the richest sources of information about the physical world — and one of the hardest to use at scale. We build complete pipelines: camera integration, model training on your conditions, edge or server inference, and dashboards and alerts that operators actually use.

## Privacy-preserving by default

Where people may appear on camera, we process video on-device where possible, store only the events and metrics you need, and apply anonymisation such as face and plate blurring.
capabilities: Anomaly and event detection with real-time alerts

outcomes.title: Faster response
outcomes.text: Operators are alerted to relevant events in seconds instead of watching screens.

outcomes.title: Consistent inspection
outcomes.text: Automated visual checks that do not tire, at production-line speed.

outcomes.title: Lower bandwidth
outcomes.text: Edge inference sends events and metadata instead of raw video streams.

outcomes.title: Actionable metrics
outcomes.text: Counts, flows and dwell times that feed planning and reporting.

seo.title: Computer Vision & Video Analytics Solutions
seo.description: Real-time computer vision from ASSERT: object detection and tracking, crowd and traffic analytics, visual inspection and privacy-preserving edge AI.

title: Internet of Things & Edge
summary: Connected sensors, devices and edge computing that turn physical assets and environments into reliable, real-time data.
intro: We design IoT systems end to end — from sensors and gateways to secure data pipelines, edge processing and the applications that make the data useful.
body:
## Reliable data from the physical world

IoT projects succeed or fail on the basics: devices that keep working in the field, connectivity that tolerates interruptions, and data that can be trusted. Our embedded-systems background means we design for these realities from the start.

## Intelligence at the edge

Processing data close to where it is generated reduces latency, bandwidth and cost — and keeps systems running when the network does not. We combine edge computing with cloud or on-premise platforms for the best of both.
capabilities: Secure telemetry pipelines (MQTT, HTTP, LoRaWAN, cellular)
Device fleet management and over-the-air updates
Integration with ERP, maintenance and business systems

outcomes.title: Visibility in real time
outcomes.text: Know the state of assets, stock and environments without manual checks.

outcomes.title: Less downtime
outcomes.text: Condition monitoring and alerts that catch problems early.

outcomes.title: Resilient operation
outcomes.text: Edge logic that keeps working when connectivity is lost.

outcomes.title: Secure by design
outcomes.text: Device identity, encrypted communication and controlled updates.

title: Defence & Security
summary: Mission-oriented software, situational awareness, sensor integration and secure decision-support systems.
intro: ASSERT develops software and intelligent systems for defence, security and mission-critical environments, with emphasis on interoperability, situational awareness, resilience and operational usability.
body:
## Designed for demanding environments

Mission-critical systems must work under pressure, with limited connectivity and strict security requirements. We engineer for resilience, clear operator interfaces and secure integration with existing platforms.

## Multi-modal awareness

By combining video, radar, acoustic and other sensor data with AI-assisted analysis, we help operators detect threats earlier and with fewer false alarms.
